addons.title: World Of AI (Entire Collection)
addons.description:
# World Of AI
`"Finally.. No more dogshit download speed limit *cough cough* Flyawaysimulations.com *cough cough* "`

Brought to you by.. no one. its freeware. this is a backup.

Do not install this in anything above P3D V3. P3D V4, V5 and V6 are 64bit which means WoA will not work. You're better off finding FLAi models and attaching it to AIG flightplans.

Backup by VH-TAZU

callouts.text: World of AI shut down around 2015~ to my knowledge and most if not all of these AI flightplans are pre 2013. Aircraft that were introduced years after are not included. Such as you wont see a A350 at all or you'll more A340's then IRL.

addons.title: Umapyoi! (Menu Mod for MSFS2024)
addons.description:
# Umapyoi!
this is a test of the like repo system for the Skybound Hanger

this mod simply replaces 

1: the loading screen with "UMA NEW WORLD" from the Cygames youtube channel (With extra videos if you'd like within Content\VIDEOS)

2: Replaces the MSFS2024 logo with the JP Umamusume logo.

3: Replaces the Menu Music with "Tracen Academy Day" and "Tracen Academy Night"
